system.description:
You can use [Charm] items with an Item Rank equal to or less than your [CR+SR]. You gain +(SRx3) [Inventory Slots]. You can only store [Charms] in these additional [Inventory Slots], and the stored items cannot be subjected to undesired effects, such as actions other than yours, or the [Exhaustion Table: Items].

You are good at handling talismans. You can wield more and higher amulets at will.
